description:
A menu item has been incorrectly categorized in the system. Your task is to reassign the item 'Garlic Naan' from its current category ('ENTREE') to the 'SIDES' category using the Floreant POS Back Office.

Steps:
1. Click BACK OFFICE on the main POS terminal screen.
2. Enter the Administrator PIN: 1111, then click OK (or Login).
3. Navigate to the 'Menu Items' section (usually under Explorers).
4. Locate the item 'Garlic Naan' in the list.
5. Edit the item and change its Category to 'SIDES'.
6. Save your changes.

The item must be assigned to the 'SIDES' category to pass verification.
